name: Gemini CLI MCP/OpenAI Bridge
description: Exposes Gemini CLI's built-in tools and external MCP proxies through a unified MCP endpoint while providing an OpenAI-compatible API for Gemini models. It features configurable security modes to safely manage file system operations, web searches, and shell command execution.

rawRecord.description: Exposes Gemini CLI's built-in tools and external MCP proxies through a unified MCP endpoint while providing an OpenAI-compatible API for Gemini models. It features configurable security modes to safely manage file system operations, web searches, and shell command execution.

GEMINI_API_KEY.description: API key for authentication. The server automatically uses this if provided.

GEMINI_MCP_HOST.description: Host address for the server to listen on. Use 0.0.0.0 to listen on all network interfaces.

GEMINI_MCP_PORT.description: Port for the server to listen on.

GEMINI_TOOLS_DEFAULT_MODEL.description: Default model for tool execution, such as web search summarization.

GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS.description: Path to the Google application credentials JSON file for authentication.
